logp.method_description: The log Po/w values of the complex [LIr], were determined by using the shake flask method. A known amount of each complex (2 mg) was suspended in PBS solution (pre-saturated with n-octanol) and shaken for 48 h on an orbital shaker. For the phase separation, the solution was centrifuged for 10 min at 3000 rpm. To obtain the partition coefficient, different ratios (1: 2 and 2: 1) of the saturated solutions were shaken with pre-saturated n-octanol for 20 min on an orbital shaker, following the same procedure. Then the partition coefficient (Po/w) was calculated by taking the Coctanol/Cwater ratio and the lipophilicities of the respective complexes were determined from log Po/w.
